name: UnravelX Chatbot
author: unravelx

sections.description:
UnravelX is an AI-powered sales and support chatbot that helps businesses convert website visitors into leads.

This plugin lets you connect your WordPress site to your UnravelX chatbot in under a minute:

  1. Install and activate this plugin
  2. Go to Settings → UnravelX Chatbot
  3. Paste your Chatbot ID (found in your UnravelX dashboard)
  4. Enable the chatbot and save

The chatbot button will appear on every page of your site automatically.

Features:

  • One-field setup — just your Chatbot ID
  • Enable / disable without losing your settings
  • Clean uninstall — no leftover data
  • No coding required

Requirements:

  • An active UnravelX account
  • Your Chatbot ID from the UnravelX dashboard
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/unravelx-chatbot/, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings → UnravelX Chatbot.
  4. Enter your Chatbot ID and enable the chatbot.
  5. Save. Done.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Chatbot ID?

Log in to your UnravelX dashboard at app.unravelx.com, open your chatbot’s settings, and copy the ID shown there.

The chatbot isn’t showing up. What do I do?

Try clearing your site cache and visiting the site in a private/incognito window. If it still doesn’t appear, make sure the Enable toggle is on and the Chatbot ID is saved correctly.

Does this slow down my site?

No. The chatbot script loads asynchronously and deferred, so it does not block page rendering.

What data does this plugin store?

Only your Chatbot ID and the enabled/disabled state, stored in wp_options. No visitor data is collected by the plugin itself.
